summary: Semantic tags can be styled by name, the same as p or h1. This page gives the header a colored band and the aside a left border.
notes: header h1 matches only the h1 inside the header.
Links are inline elements, so they sit side by side in the nav. margin-right spaces them out.
Semantic tags have no special look by default. All of the style here comes from this file.
pitfall: Expecting <aside> to appear as a sidebar on its own. Every one of these tags stacks top to bottom until you add layout CSS (flexbox or grid, later).
